title: 2020 AMC 12A Problem 4
statement: How many \(4\)-digit positive integers (that is, integers between \(1000\) and \(9999,\) inclusive) having only even digits are divisible by \(5?\)

solutions.text:
To be divisible by \(5\) the last digit is \(0\) or \(5,\) and to be even it must be \(0.\) So the units digit is fixed.

The leading digit is a nonzero even digit: \(2, 4, 6, 8\) give \(4\) choices. Each of the two middle digits is any even digit \(0, 2, 4, 6, 8,\) giving \(5\) choices each.

The total is \(4 \cdot 5 \cdot 5 \cdot 1 = 100.\)

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: A number divisible by \(5\) ends in \(0\) or \(5,\) but the last digit must also be even
Count the choices for each digit: the leading digit cannot be \(0\)
